priority_items.title: Fiji CRC timetable races 24 Dec writ; report still unpublished (collection catch-up)
priority_items.summary: FijiVillage and Fiji Times report Cabinet endorsement to table the CRC report at a 22 Sep 11:30 special sitting, debate from 28 Sep, referendum Nov–mid-Dec, proposed in-force 24 Dec 2026 (also the last date a writ of election can be issued; last GE date 6 Feb 2027). Tabling is not acceptance of all recommendations. CRC report not public. National Referendum Bill unpassed. fiji.gov.fj news list still silent. Legal amendment path, not extra-constitutional. Not FLASH. Missed in earlier 16 Sep hourlies.
